Let
\[
\beta(s)=L(s,\chi_4),\qquad \ell=\frac{\beta'(1)}{\beta(1)}.
\]
Define the absolutely convergent products
\[
P_-=\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}\frac{(1-p^{-2})^{1/2}}{1-p^{-3}},
\qquad
P_+=\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}\frac{(1-p^{-2})^{1/2}}{1+p^{-3}},
\]
and the absolutely convergent prime sums
\[
a_-=\frac{\log2}{2}+\sum_{p\equiv3(4)}
\left(\frac{\log p}{p^2-1}-\frac{3\log p}{p^3-1}\right),
\]
\[
a_+=\frac{\log2}{2}+\sum_{p\equiv3(4)}
\left(\frac{\log p}{p^2-1}+\frac{3\log p}{p^3+1}\right).
\]
Then set
\[
d_-=\frac12\left(1-\frac{\gamma+\ell}{2}-a_-\right),
\qquad
d_+=\frac12\left(1-\frac{\gamma+\ell}{2}-a_+\right).
\]

For the untwisted series,
\[
F(s)=\sum_{n\in\mathcal S}\frac1{n^s}
=\prod_{p\equiv1(4)}(1-p^{-s})^{-1}
\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}(1-p^{-3s})^{-1}.
\]
For the twisted series,
\[
G(s)=\sum_{n\in\mathcal S}\frac{\chi_4(n)}{n^s}
=\prod_{p\equiv1(4)}(1-p^{-s})^{-1}
\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}(1+p^{-3s})^{-1}.
\]
Using
\[
\zeta(s)\beta(s)
=(1-2^{-s})^{-1}
\prod_{p\equiv1(4)}(1-p^{-s})^{-2}
\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}(1-p^{-2s})^{-1},
\]
we get
\[
F(s)=(\zeta(s)\beta(s))^{1/2}A_-(s),
\quad
A_-(s)=(1-2^{-s})^{1/2}
\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}
\frac{(1-p^{-2s})^{1/2}}{1-p^{-3s}},
\]
\[
G(s)=(\zeta(s)\beta(s))^{1/2}A_+(s),
\quad
A_+(s)=(1-2^{-s})^{1/2}
\prod_{p\equiv3(4)}
\frac{(1-p^{-2s})^{1/2}}{1+p^{-3s}}.
\]
Since \(\beta(1)=\pi/4\),
\[
A_-(1)=\frac{P_-}{\sqrt2},\qquad A_+(1)=\frac{P_+}{\sqrt2}.
\]

The square-root singularity contribution is: if
\[
H(s)=(s-1)^{-1/2}(b_0+b_1(s-1)+O((s-1)^2)),
\]
then
\[
\sum_{n\le x}h_n
=\frac{b_0x}{\sqrt{\pi\log x}}
\left(1+\frac{1-b_1/b_0}{2\log x}
+O((\log x)^{-2})\right).
\]
Here
\[
\frac{b_1}{b_0}
=\frac{\gamma+\ell}{2}+\frac{A_\pm'(1)}{A_\pm(1)},
\]
and the logarithmic derivatives are exactly \(a_\pm\). Thus
\[
\sum_{\substack{n\le x\\ n\in\mathcal S}}1
=\frac{P_-}{2\sqrt2}\frac{x}{\sqrt{\log x}}
\left(1+\frac{d_-}{\log x}+O((\log x)^{-2})\right),
\]
\[
\sum_{\substack{n\le x\\ n\in\mathcal S}}\chi_4(n)
=\frac{P_+}{2\sqrt2}\frac{x}{\sqrt{\log x}}
\left(1+\frac{d_+}{\log x}+O((\log x)^{-2})\right).
\]
Since
\[
N_1=\frac12(F\text{-count}+G\text{-count}),\qquad
N_3=\frac12(F\text{-count}-G\text{-count}),
\]
we obtain
\[
C_1=\frac{P_-+P_+}{4\sqrt2},
\qquad
C_3=\frac{P_--P_+}{4\sqrt2},
\]
\[
D_1=\frac{P_-d_-+P_+d_+}{P_-+P_+},
\qquad
D_3=\frac{P_-d_--P_+d_+}{P_--P_+}.
\]
Also,
\[
\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{N_1(x)}{N_3(x)}
=\frac{P_-+P_+}{P_--P_+}.
\]

Therefore the requested tuple is
\[
\boxed{
\left(
\frac{P_-+P_+}{4\sqrt2},
\frac{P_--P_+}{4\sqrt2},
\frac{P_-d_-+P_+d_+}{P_-+P_+},
\frac{P_-d_--P_+d_+}{P_--P_+}
\right)
}.
\]
